scope: Local analysis plan written before fitting any model in this experiment; not an externally preregistered study.
dataset: All 3000 checksum-pinned UCI Sentiment Labelled Sentences records in source-manifest order.

inner_split.method: EvalCheck connected components on outer training pool

word_char_union.representation: unweighted feature union of word and char_wb TF-IDF

selection: Highest development macro-F1 among all three models, including baseline. Ties: lexicographically smallest model name. No test predictions for unselected non-baseline candidates.
final_fit: Keep models fitted on training only; no refit on development. Compare selected model against baseline on identical test rows.
primary_metric: macro-F1 with explicit labels [0,1] and zero_division=0

uncertainty.method: paired percentile bootstrap over outer test connected components

claim_boundary: A model representation comparison under an audited split. This does not estimate EvalCheck's causal effect on model accuracy. No claim of general improvement across datasets or split seeds.
stop_rule: Report the result even if it shows no improvement, a negative delta, or an interval including zero. Do not revise candidates using final test results.
